decisions.target: small business owners with a Cobalt card reader

actions.action: Instant dispute credit up to $100 per customer, 8 weeks
Debit card cash back for 4 weeks
Early pay up to 2 days early, permanently

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. For the next 8 weeks, if you dispute a card charge we credit up to $100 right away. For 4 weeks your Cobalt debit card earns 1%, up to $5 cash back. Paychecks paid into Cobalt can now show up to 2 days early, so Friday Dec 11 pay may arrive by Wed Dec 9.
decisions.why:

Cost $2,100,000 of the $4M budget.
